# DERMATOLOGIC SURGERY POST-OPERATIVE ANTIBIOTIC PROPHYLAXIS

**Des Moines Guidance (Inpatient):**

REFER TO SYNDROME OR INFECTIOUS DISEASE FOR RECOMMENDATIONS Recommendations based on isolation of this specific pathogen are not available.
Please refer to the syndrome or infectious disease caused by this pathogen for antimicrobial therapy recommendations.

**Minneapolis Guidance:**

# RECOMMENDATIONS

Conditions that may warrant dermatologic surgery post-operative antibiotic prophylaxis:

1. Large wound (>5cm)
2. Long procedure where wound is open for a long time
3. Wound near cartilage or bone (e.g. some nose, scalp or ear sites)

If patient received pre-operative antibiotics, select the same antibiotic for post-operative prophylaxis. Duration of antimicrobial prophylaxis should not exceed 24 hours. Durations longer than 24 hours have not been shown effective in preventing surgical site infections.

# Operations involving trunk or extremity away from axilla or perineum

Cephalexin 500 mg PO QID, three doses post-operatively ($) R

Penicillin allergy or MRSA risk factors
Trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole 1 DS tablet BID, one dose post-operatively ($)

[R,DI]

Severe infections or patients unable to take oral medications
[Cefazolin Weight Based Dosing q8h x2 doses postop](surg-cefazolin-wt-based-postop-doses-x2)

Penicillin allergy or MRSA risk factors and severe infection or patient unable to take oral medications
[Vancomycin 15mg/kg Dosing q12h x1 dose postop](surg-vancomycin-post-op-specific-dosing)

# Operations involving the axilla or perineum

Cephalexin 500 mg PO QID, three doses post-operatively ($) R <AND>
metronidazole 500 mg PO TID, two doses post-operatively ($) [DI]

Penicillin allergy
Ciprofloxacin 500 mg PO BID, one dose post-operatively ($) R,DI <AND>
metronidazole 500 mg PO TID, two doses post-operatively ($) [DI]

MRSA risk factors
Trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole 1 DS tablet BID, one dose post-operatively ($)
[R,DI] <AND> metronidazole 500 mg PO q8h, two doses post-operatively ($) [DI]

Severe infections or unable to take oral medications
Note: ceftriaxone does not require redosing due to it's long half-live
Metronidazole 500 mg IV q8h, two doses post-operatively ($) DI

Penicillin allergy and severe infections or unable to take oral medications
Ciprofloxacin 400 mg IV q12h, one dose post-operatively ($) R,DI <AND>
metronidazole 500 mg IV q8h, two doses post-operatively ($) [DI]

MRSA risk factors and severe infections or unable to take oral medications < ADD > to one of the above IV regimens for operations involving axilla or perineum
[Vancomycin 15mg/kg Dosing q12h x1 dose postop](surg-vancomycin-post-op-specific-dosing)

- Nishimura et al, J Am Coll Cardiol (2014) 63, e57-185

- Up-to-Date article: Antimicrobial prophylaxis for prevention of surgical site infection in adults
- Up-to-Date article: Antimicrobial prophylaxis for the prevention of bacterial endocarditis

Inpt: ORZID2 GMENU ABX DERM POST-OP INFECTIONS
Therapy:
**Minneapolis Guidance:**

## Continuation of pre-operative antibiotics that are not listed above

Note: azithromycin and ceftriaxone do not require redosing due to their long half-lives
Amoxicillin 500 mg PO BID, one dose post-operatively ($) R
< OR >
Trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole 1 DS tablet BID, one dose post-operatively ($)
[R,DI] < AND > Penicillin VK 500 mg PO TID, 2 doses post-operatively ($) [R]

< OR >
Ampicillin 2 gm IV q6h, 3 doses post-operatively ($$) R
< OR >
